possible_values: 01 = Branca (White) | 02 = Preta (Black) | 03 = Parda (Mixed/Brown) | 04 = Amarela (Asian/Yellow) | 05 = Indigena (Indigenous) | 99 = Sem informacao (Not informed)
grouping_guidance: *** DISCREPANCY FOUND, RESOLVED -- read before using ***  The official ETL wiki decode table literally lists code 05 as "Amarela" (same as code 04), which would be a duplicate/error. However, directly-decoded real values from the PCDaS preview output confirm 05 = "Indigena", matching the standard, current official Brazilian classification (IBGE-aligned, also used in the Coelho/Rocha/Hone 2024 academic paper on this exact field -- see references.md). CONCLUSION: use 05=Indigena. The wiki's 2019 documentation table almost certainly contains a copy-paste error for this one row; treat the real decoded data and external academic corroboration as authoritative over the wiki text for this specific code only. Code 99 declined 48% over 2024 (282->146), consistent with a documented national completeness-improvement trend -- not noise. ADDITIONAL CROSS-CHECK (2026-09-01): SIM subsystem's dictionary (dict_SIM.csv) lists codes 3/4 in the reverse order (3=Amarela, 4=Parda) vs. this project's SIH mapping (3=Parda, 4=Amarela). Documented in references.md as a specific two-document discrepancy, not a general SIM-vs-SIH claim. No change made -- SIH mapping retained, supported by two independent agreeing sources (see references.md for full reasoning).

translation: Hospital's regional payment-superintendence linkage (state-level administrative code)
possible_values: NOT a simple category list -- see caveat below. No official decode/enrichment step exists for this field anywhere in the documented PCDaS ETL pipeline.
grouping_guidance: EXCLUDE from Q1 -- confirmed, do not reconsider. Three independent findings converge: (1) official DATASUS Notas Tecnicas documentation states this field can diverge from the hospital's actual physical location by design (payment-system linkage, not geography); (2) official RD file layout defines it as a 2-character STATE-level code (C(02), ~27-28 possible values per the official UF.csv table) -- but our actual data shows 2,134 unique values, structurally incompatible with a 2-digit code; (3) the complete official ETL wiki decode-table listing has NO entry for UF_ZI at all -- PCDaS's own pipeline does not attempt to decode or enrich this field, consistent with it being a low-analytical-value administrative artifact rather than a genuine geography variable.
